senses.gloss:
A word in the masculine gender, similarly spoken along with the same word, but ending with the feminine affix, becomes एकशेष and the latter is dropped.

Terms: एकशेष

रु is substituted for the म् of पुम् (whereby the उ is changed to उँ or उं) before a surd mute (खय्) which is followed by a vowel, semi-vowel or a nasal (अम् प्रत्यहार).

Terms: Nasal रु
